name: Cyberpunk
tagline: High tech, low life, neon rain.
what_it_means: Cyberpunk design depicts a dystopian neon future: dark rainy cityscapes, aggressive yellow/magenta/cyan neon, angular clipped corner panels, HUD overlays, Japanese signage and glitch. It feels edgy, futuristic and immersive, like the UI of a sci-fi game.
signature_moves: Dark city backdrops with neon glow
Acid yellow + hot magenta + cyan accents
Katakana / kanji, glitch and warning stripes
best_for: Games, esports, tech launches, streetwear, sci-fi content
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a game landing page for [GAME] in a Cyberpunk style. Dark rainy neon city backdrop (#0A0A12) with silhouetted skyscrapers and glowing signs in katakana. UI panels have sharp clipped corners (clip-path polygons), thin cyan (#00F0FF) borders and HUD brackets, coordinates and small data readouts. Primary accent is acid yellow (#FCEE0A) with hot red-magenta (#FF003C) for warnings. Headline in Orbitron / Chakra Petch, uppercase, with a slight glitch offset. Angular yellow CTA button with a notched corner, yellow-black warning stripes, rain streaks and flicker animations.
